categories.main_business_segments: Tae Yang Metal Industrial Co. Ltd primarily operates in the manufacturing and sale of cold-forged products for automotive and electronic parts. The company produces bolts, screws, nuts, washers, and related components used in automobiles, machinery, electrical, and electronic products. It operates a dominant single business segment focused on cold-forged automotive and electronic parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cold forging technology for producing metal parts, relying on advanced design and technical expertise. Production is based on customer order manufacturing with a multi-product, small-lot production system. The company invests in new manufacturing methods and materials, including aluminum alloy wire manufacturing and high-strength cold forging wire forming technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automobile manufacturers such as Hyundai Motor Company, Kia Motors, and GM Korea, as well as automotive parts suppliers like Hyundai Mobis and Mando. The products also serve machinery, tool manufacturers, and electrical battery companies like LG E&S. The primary market is the automotive industry, both domestic and international, including exports to the US, EU, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates domestically in South Korea with headquarters in Ansan, Gyeonggi Province, and manufacturing sites in Wonju. Overseas subsidiaries and production facilities are located in China (Yantai, Zhangjiagang), India (Chennai), the United States (Detroit, Franklin), and Mexico (Ramos Arizpe). The company serves global markets with a focus on North America, China, India, and Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tae Yang Metal Industrial Co. Ltd operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of cold-forged metal components. It sources raw materials such as cold forging wire rods from steel producers like POSCO and supplies finished parts directly to automotive OEMs and parts manufacturers, positioning itself as a key component supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes securing international-level technological competitiveness through R&D focused on new manufacturing methods and new materials for forging products. It operates an in-house technology research institute with teams dedicated to design, development, steering design, advanced research, and materials research. Recent R&D projects include aluminum alloy wire manufacturing, high-strength cold forging wire forming, new steel materials, and dissimilar material joining technologies aimed at vehicle lightweighting.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cold-forged automotive and electronic parts. The company sells products both domestically and internationally, including exports. It also generates revenue from sales of raw materials such as cold forging wire rods. There are no long-term sales contracts; sales are based on customer orders and short-term transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tae Yang Metal Industrial Co. Ltd is the largest domestic manufacturer of cold-forged automotive bolts and nuts in South Korea, holding approximately 35% market share as of 2022. Major competitors include Jin Hap (about 30%), Sunil Die Pass (about 20%), and Youngshin Metal (about 15%). The market is highly competitive with many small and medium-sized companies, but Tae Yang leads in quality and scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 617 billion KRW, an 8.4% increase from the previous year, with operating profit of about 22 billion KRW and net profit turning positive. Total assets were about 497 billion KRW with liabilities of 388 billion KRW, reflecting a growing but leveraged financial profile. Production volume increased by 4.3% in 2023, and the company continues to invest in capacity and cost reduction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages its long history, advanced technical expertise, and superior design capabilities to provide high-quality cold-forged products under the 'TMC' brand. It emphasizes international quality standards, including ISO 14001 and ISO/TS 16949 certifications, and maintains a strong focus on quality control with low defect rates. Tae Yang differentiates itself through technological innovation, cost competitiveness, and reliable supply to major global automotive manufacturers.
